title: No-stub gate lacked executable proof

evidence.excerpt: text search accepted pass and ellipsis-only bodies

impact: release evidence could contradict active source
recommended_action: add AST-based release-readiness validation and CI enforcement

title: Malformed JavaScript manifest was silently ignored

evidence.excerpt: JSON and key errors ended in pass

impact: dependency topology could be incomplete without a failure signal
recommended_action: fail closed with repository-scoped validation errors

title: Required release handoff artifacts were absent

evidence.excerpt: manifest, final tree, Unknown register, regression guard, and traceability map absent

impact: operators could not verify inventory, residual risk, or fix provenance

title: Initial repository lacked complete governance and operator root surface

evidence.excerpt: architecture, governance, maintainership, support, release, development, threat, dependency, license, notice, and initial-commit authorities were incomplete or absent

impact: the implementation could run but could not be governed, released, supported, or handed off as a durable repository baseline
recommended_action: add the complete source-aligned root authority surface

title: Highest-risk architecture decisions lacked durable ADRs

evidence.excerpt: no accepted ADR set existed for packet boundaries, evidence, determinism, effects, orchestration, storage, or publication ownership

impact: future changes could silently reverse core v5 decisions without an explicit supersession process
recommended_action: add and index 20 accepted validation-backed ADRs

title: Canonical build source was not preserved as a standalone implementation authority

evidence.excerpt: full source-aligned v5 contract was added with source repository, commit, and blob lineage

impact: implementation intent could drift away from the design that produced the repository
recommended_action: retain BUILD_SPECIFICATION.md as the full initial repository build authority

title: Validated package and committed tree diverged
impact: release evidence could approve a non-runnable commit
recommended_action: bind manifest and validation to git ls-tree and exact commit identity

title: Idempotency omitted output-affecting policies

evidence.excerpt: risk, maturity, report, packet, and output policy omitted

impact: stale packets could be reused after semantic policy changes

title: Dispatch could select callback secret and destination

evidence.excerpt: packet supplied URL and env variable name

impact: worker secrets could be exfiltrated to an attacker-controlled endpoint
recommended_action: use worker-local callback registry and network policy

title: Publication verification was not bound to expected packet identity

evidence.excerpt: verified only that the URI contained a valid bundle

recommended_action: require digest-qualified references and exact PacketRef verification

title: Upstream diagnostics were silently dropped

evidence.excerpt: diagnostics preserved in normalization but absent from state

impact: upstream uncertainty could disappear from a structurally valid topology
recommended_action: preserve typed diagnostics and enforce conservation

title: Bundle and local registry commits were not transaction-safe

evidence.excerpt: per-file bundle writes and JSON read-modify-write

impact: partial bundles or lost local recovery updates
recommended_action: atomic staged directory rename and SQLite WAL transactions

title: Validation receipts blurred model construction and independent schema validation

evidence.excerpt: schema checks were unconditionally passed after model construction

recommended_action: separate validation layers and execute checked-in JSON Schemas

title: Callback string-prefix policy permitted sibling paths
impact: a callback could leave the intended path namespace while satisfying the old string-prefix check
recommended_action: use exact-or-segment-descendant matching and reject encoded separators

title: Release integrity bound paths but not committed blob identities

evidence.excerpt: path equality and manifest file hash did not prove per-file content identity

impact: same-path content substitution could evade the stated integrity claim
recommended_action: add a Git-native path, mode, object-type, and blob-ID manifest

title: OCI publication used a configured mutable target before digest authority

evidence.excerpt: publish target could be a shared mutable tag

impact: concurrent publishers could race before immutable digest capture
recommended_action: publish through a semantic-hash-derived staging tag and independently resolve the descriptor digest
